text:
anya: kicking off a short sprint to clean up ownerless admin entitlements across prod and staging. plan: run owner-mapper, verify KMS grants, remove stale roles. aiming for Wed EOD. volunteers?

mike: +1. can we gate on last-used <90d?

jon: yes, use auditlog query: `SELECT principal, last_auth FROM auth_events WHERE role = 'admin' AND last_auth < now() - interval '90 days'` — I can run in staging.

tori: FYI there's a known KMS log gap for org projects 12-15, see #incidents thread — how do we handle those?

anya: good catch. for those projects we'll do owner-proof via PR and manual approval. doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/admin-cleanup (please read the Approval checklist section)

liz: can sec-bot run a canary prune? we should not mass-revoke. propose canary set = 50 principals across infra/analytics. observe 24h.

sec-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-03-24T18:00Z. will snapshot IAM & KMS bindings and emit alerts to #eng-security if any 403 spikes occur. :robot_face:

mike: also add KMS grant check: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/ORG/locations/global/keyRings/kr --format=json` then filter bindings for members missing owner tags. I'll paste the small jq filter once I run it.

jon: I'll prep a csv of candidates + last_auth and attach screenshots for audit evidence. i'll include recommended owner (if any) or "orphan" tag. ETA tomorrow morning.

anya: tasking: mike -> staging query + canary list, jon -> csv + evidence, tori -> KMS-gap manual approvals, liz -> runbook updates and rollback play. devon please be on standby for CI fallout.

devon: question: what's rollback if a CI job starts failing post-prune? immediate re-grant to a temp-admin group or create a support exception? need explicit policy for auditors.

anya: policy: immediate re-grant to a "temp-admins/prune-rollback" group with 24h expiry, then open a ticket and follow remediation playbook (see runbook). all re-grants must be logged with justification.

mike: noted. i'll add the expiry script snippet to the runbook: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJ --member=$PRINCIPAL --role='roles/owner' --condition=None && at now + 24 hours echo revoke-script | sh` (will refine).

tori: for the KMS-gap projects i'll create PR templates that include owner attestation and attach to the csv rows. manual approval only after two approvers.

anya: thanks team. mike/jon/liz please ping here with canary snapshots. we'll do a short retro after canary completes. :thumbsup:
